name: Tahini (sesame paste, hulled, roasted)
note: USDA SR26 12166 (Seeds, sesame butter, tahini, from roasted and toasted kernels - most common type). Plain tahini only: 100% sesame, no salt, garlic, lemon or sweetener (check the jar). Very energy-dense (~6 kcal/g, 54% fat): small amounts - go carefully if prone to pancreatitis or loose stools. Phosphorus 732 mg/100 g = ~1.2 g/1000 kcal, about the top of the renal range; oil adds energy with no phosphorus. Good source of copper, iron and zinc. Wholegrain (unhulled) tahini is much higher in calcium and oxalate. Oxalate unknown: whole sesame seeds ~380 mg/100 g, hulled tahini lower - avoid with calcium-oxalate stones.
